banner.message: Verify your email to unlock cloud features. We sent a link to {{email}}.
banner.undeliverable: We couldn't deliver mail to {{email}}. Check the address and change it if it's wrong.

modal.title: Verify your email first
modal.body: Cloud upgrades require a verified email address. Check your inbox for the verification link, or send a new one.

toast.verifiedPending: Not verified yet. Open the link in your email, then try again.
toast.verifiedUnknown: Email verified. Sign in to continue.
toast.undeliverable: Mail to this address bounces, so we can't send the link. Change your email in Settings → Account.

seededPluginsFailed.message: Built-in plugins failed to load, so the app is running without them. This is a bug — please report it.

awaitingKey.message: Waiting for a {{team}} owner to grant vault access

membershipEnded.message: You were removed from {{team}}. Its hosts, keys and snippets are gone from this device, and credentials you used there should be rotated.

secretsNotWiped.message: Some {{team}} credentials could not be removed from this device. They stay readable here until the wipe succeeds.

sshConfigMigrated.message: Your ~/.ssh/config hosts are no longer synced automatically. They are yours now: your changes are kept.

sshConfigOffer.message_one: {{count}} host found in ~/.ssh/config. Import it into Voltius? You can edit it freely afterwards.
sshConfigOffer.message_other: {{count}} hosts found in ~/.ssh/config. Import them into Voltius? You can edit them freely afterwards.

sshConfigSync.unreadable: ~/.ssh/config could not be read. Managed hosts are kept as they are.
sshConfigSync.vaultGone: The vault picked for ~/.ssh/config hosts no longer exists. Pick another one in Settings › Hosts.
sshConfigSync.detachedToTeam_one: A host moved to a team vault no longer follows ~/.ssh/config.
sshConfigSync.detachedToTeam_other: {{count}} hosts moved to a team vault no longer follow ~/.ssh/config.
sshConfigSync.reviewHere: ~/.ssh/config sync is on for your account. Review this computer's hosts and keys before it syncs here.
sshConfigSync.detachedUnsynced_one: A host excluded from sync no longer follows ~/.ssh/config, so your other computers stop waiting for it.
sshConfigSync.detachedUnsynced_other: {{count}} hosts excluded from sync no longer follow ~/.ssh/config, so your other computers stop waiting for them.
sshConfigSync.detachedProxied_one: A host whose ~/.ssh/config entry now uses ProxyCommand no longer follows the file.
sshConfigSync.detachedProxied_other: {{count}} hosts whose ~/.ssh/config entries now use ProxyCommand no longer follow the file.
